fact: The Lesotho Communications Authority's annual report 2024/25 states the Universal Service Fund, established under s.33 of the Communications Act 2012, funds telecommunications extension to unserved and underserved areas.

Public Eye reports the Community Digital Inclusion Model was launched with UNDP and the Ministries of Education and Communications to turn school computer labs into centres giving underserved and remote communities digital access, skills training and e-government services.
A Vodacom Lesotho tower at Ha-Tsepe, Leribe, funded by the Universal Service Fund and the AfDB, was inaugurated and connects 10 villages.
